snippet.title: Fossara | Shovel Direct Trailer
snippet.description:
Fossara is a free short collectathon made for the Shovels.

No rules, straightforward gameplay. Find creatures and leave whenever. 
It also has unlockable platforming moves to traverse the level.

Play it here: https://juiccedev.itch.io/fossara
